text: The town gathers
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, and Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Night 1 passes quietly in Palermo. The killers met in the dark, the officer was shown one of them, and nobody is out.
